shard.title: Shard
shard.description: Which shard of the 64 state buckets this run owns. Shard 0 owns buckets 00-15, shard 1 owns 16-31, and so on (SPEC v2 §7.2). One Apify Schedule per shard, staggered 25 minutes apart so the global per-host rate stays at 2 rps. The shard count is fixed at 4 in code: a schedule that disagreed with its siblings would double the request rate on every shared ATS host.

maxCompanies.title: Max companies
maxCompanies.description: Cap on companies swept in this run. 0 sweeps the whole shard. Use a small value for a smoke run.

costCeilingUsd.title: Cost ceiling (USD per run)
costCeilingUsd.description: Hard budget guard, per run. The run refuses to start if its estimated platform cost exceeds this and stops early — failing, so the schedule emails you — once the running estimate reaches it; removal verification also stops mid-bucket and waits for the next sweep. A full 385-company shard with the Greenhouse /departments call measured $0.0265 by this estimate ($0.023 billed) on 2026-08-29: 1.5x headroom. The monthly cap is separate: the run refuses to start once meta.spend passes $4.90.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Companies fetched in parallel inside one bucket. The per-host token bucket in core.http still caps each ATS host at 2 rps (1 rps for Lever), so this only helps across providers.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Per-request timeout handed to the shared HTTP client.

maxVerifyRequests.title: Removal verification cap (requests per run)
maxVerifyRequests.description: Greenhouse and Lever `removed` events are confirmed against the provider's single-posting endpoint (404 = closed) before they are recorded; this caps those extra GETs per run. Candidates past the cap wait for the next sweep and are recorded `verified: false` after three consecutive unverified sweeps, so a shard capped on consecutive days records its overflow two days late. 1,000 covers a layoff day (2026-08-28: 1,120 removals over four shards); the cost ceiling and run deadline bound the clock.

reseedWatchlist.title: Reseed the watchlist
reseedWatchlist.description: Merge the company directory back into the stored watchlist before sweeping. Companies already tracked are never dropped (§7.6).

force.title: Force re-collection
force.description: Re-diff buckets already collected today. Off, a restarted run resumes and skips them.

purgeProvider.title: Takedown: purge a provider
purgeProvider.description: §15.1 policy 4. When set, the run performs a takedown instead of a sweep: every state bucket and every stored event file is rewritten with this provider's rows removed, then the run exits. Leave empty for a normal run.

purgeCompany.title: Takedown: limit the purge to one company
purgeCompany.description: Used only with the purge field above. The company slug to drop; empty purges the whole provider.
